dedupe_keys.name: atlas des zones inondables du nord pas de calais

description: Atlas des zones inondables du Nord-Pas de Calais is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Presentation of 100-year, 10-year and higher floods than flood hazard and flood expansion areas. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Atlas of the flood zones of Nord-Pas de Calais" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Risques, Hydrologie / Hydrographie, Risques naturels liés à l'eau, Zones à risque naturel. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
